changeSet.author: CIV developer
changeSet.comment: The Validation submenus (routine, immunology, biochemistry, serology, DNA PCR, viral load, genotyping, accession search, accession range search) still had legacy .do action URLs, so they fell through the React router's catch-all route and forced a full navigation to the old JSP interface. Point them at the existing React routes instead, following the pattern already used for menu_resultvalidation_date (/ResultValidationByTestDate) and the Reports/Pathology/Cytology/Immunochemistry menu migrations.

changeSet.author: CIV developer
changeSet.comment: The routine Validation search page (/ResultValidation) supports pre-selecting a test section via a ?testSectionId=<id> query parameter (see frontend/src/components/validation/SearchForm.js). Point each section-specific Validation submenu at its matching clinlims.test_section row so the link actually filters to that section again, instead of landing on the generic unfiltered form. DNA PCR / Viral Load / Genotyping are individual tests inside the "Virologie" test section (not separate sections), so all three resolve to that same section id - the new UI does not yet support filtering by individual test name within a section.

changeSet.author: CIV developer
changeSet.comment: DNA PCR / Viral Load / Genotyping all resolve to the same "Virologie" test section id (see fix-validation-submenu-urls-testsection-filter above), so the three submenus looked identical. Append a &test=<name> parameter that SearchForm.js now reads to further filter the section's results down to the specific test (matched against the "testName" field of each result row).
